intro_en: Chef Kang Mingoo's flagship is Korea's only three-star restaurant, built around the country's fermented sauces (jang) and seasonal produce. His tasting menu reworks Korean home and royal-court flavours with Western technique, keeping dishes light yet deeply savoury.
intro_zh: 主厨姜珉求（Kang Mingoo）的旗舰店是韩国唯一的米其林三星餐厅，以韩国传统发酵酱料（酱）和时令食材为核心。他的品鉴菜单用西式技法重新演绎韩国家常与宫廷风味，口感轻盈却鲜味浓郁。
highlights_en: 'Jang Trio' dessert reimagining doenjang, ganjang and gochujang
Warm-toned dining room with contemporary art and garden views
Seasonal tasting menu with Korean-spirit and wine pairings
highlights_zh: 以大酱、酱油、辣椒酱为灵感的招牌甜点“酱三重奏”
暖色调用餐空间，配当代艺术与绿意窗景
时令品鉴菜单，可搭配韩国传统酒或葡萄酒

intro_en: Chef Kim Jin-hyuk trained in Japan for about five years before opening alla prima in 2015; it won a star within two years and has held two since 2019. A long counter wraps the open kitchen, and the tasting menu treats Korean seasonal produce with a free hand, borrowing Japanese, Italian and French technique without settling into any one of them.
intro_zh: 主厨金振赫在日本学艺约五年，2015 年开出 alla prima，两年内摘得一星，2019 年起保持二星。长吧台环绕开放厨房，tasting menu 以韩国当季食材为本，自由借用日、意、法的技法，却不被任何一种菜系框住。
highlights_en: Counter seating around a fully open kitchen
Menu written as ingredient trios, e.g. Olive · Peach · Caviar
Joseon-style blue-and-white bowls alongside dark stoneware
highlights_zh: 吧台座位，完整的开放式厨房就在眼前
菜单只写食材组合，如「橄榄 · 桃子 · 鱼子酱」
青花瓷碗与深色石器交替出场

intro_en: Tasmanian-born chef Joseph Lidgerwood looks at Korean ingredients through an outsider's curious eye, foraging wild plants and making his own meju, sauces and spirits. The result is a playful, research-driven tasting menu that treats Korean pantry staples in unexpected ways.
intro_zh: 出生于塔斯马尼亚的主厨约瑟夫·利杰伍德（Joseph Lidgerwood）以外来者的好奇视角探索韩国食材，亲自采集野生植物，并自制酱曲（meju）、酱料与酒。成品是一套充满趣味、以研究为驱动的品鉴菜单，用意想不到的方式演绎韩国传统食材。
highlights_en: Signature meju doughnut with anchovy dalgona and black garlic
House-brewed sauces, pine-needle oil and herbal liquors
Award-winning wine list; lunch only Fri–Sat
highlights_zh: 招牌酱曲甜甜圈，配凤尾鱼椪糖与黑蒜
自酿酱料、松针油与草本药酒
获奖酒单；仅周五、周六供应午餐

intro_en: The Seoul original of Yim Jung-sik's 'New Korean' movement, which also spawned a starred New York sibling. Familiar comfort foods like gimbap and bibimbap are reinvented as witty, refined courses that still taste unmistakably Korean.
intro_zh: 林正植（Yim Jung-sik）“新韩餐”理念的首尔本店，其纽约分店同样获得星级。紫菜包饭、拌饭等家常美食被重新诠释为风趣精致的菜品，却依然保有地道的韩国味道。
highlights_en: Playful reinterpretations of gimbap and bibimbap
Set menu opening with banchan, mains from abalone to duck
Deep wine list with well-judged pairings
highlights_zh: 对紫菜包饭、拌饭的趣味重构
套餐以小菜开场，主菜从鲍鱼到鸭肉
丰富酒单与精准配酒建议

intro_en: The name pairs the chef's surname with 'sooksoo', an old Korean word for a master banquet cook. Chef Kwon Woo-joong pairs traditional fermentation and seasonal ingredients with a calm, minimalist room.
intro_zh: 店名由主厨的姓氏与古语“熟手”（宴席名厨）组合而成。权宇中（Kwon Woo-joong）主厨将传统发酵工艺与时令食材结合，呈现于宁静简约的空间中。
highlights_en: Opening small bites paired with traditional Korean liquors
Main course served 'doksang' style on an individual table
Daily kimchi cart and dessert trolley finale
highlights_zh: 开场小食搭配韩国传统酒
主菜以“独床”形式单人一桌呈上
每日泡菜推车与甜点推车收尾

address_en: 23F, The Shilla Seoul, 249 Dongho-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul 04605
intro_en: The Shilla hotel's flagship Korean restaurant, perched on the 23rd floor with sweeping views over Namsan and the city. It presents royal and classic Korean dishes in a lighter, polished modern form, backed by gracious hotel service.
intro_zh: 新罗酒店的旗舰韩餐厅，位于23层，可俯瞰南山与城市全景。餐厅以更轻盈、精致的现代手法呈现宫廷及经典韩式菜肴，并配以周到的酒店式服务。
highlights_en: Char-grilled Hanwoo bulgogi and refined classics like sinseollo
Panoramic 23rd-floor views over Namsan
Polished hotel service; open daily for lunch and dinner
highlights_zh: 炭烤韩牛烤肉及神仙炉等精致经典菜
23层俯瞰南山的全景视野
精致酒店服务；每日供应午、晚餐

intro_en: Chef duo Kwon Young-woon and Kim Bo-mi cook seasonal Japanese courses at an intimate counter. Much of the produce—chicken, eggs, rice and vegetables—comes from Chef Kwon's family farm, and their low-waste practices earned a MICHELIN Green Star in 2026.
intro_zh: 由权英云与金宝美两位主厨在私密吧台前烹制时令日式料理。鸡肉、鸡蛋、大米和蔬菜等许多食材来自权主厨的家族农场，其减少浪费的可持续实践使餐厅在2026年获得米其林绿星。
highlights_en: Ingredients from the chef's family farm; menu changes each season
Rice-pot (kamameshi) course near the end of the meal
Counter dining with a notable sake list
highlights_zh: 食材来自主厨家族农场，菜单随季节更换
接近尾声的釜饭（kamameshi）
吧台座位，清酒单出色

intro_en: Chef Ahn Sung-jae's restaurant returned in 2025 at a new Yongsan address and went straight back into the guide at two stars. His cooking is precise and imaginative, mixing Korean ingredients with unexpected textures and flavour combinations.
intro_zh: 安成宰（Ahn Sung-jae）主厨的餐厅于2025年在龙山新址重开，随即重返指南并获二星。他的料理精准而富想象力，将韩国食材与意想不到的口感和风味组合相结合。
highlights_en: Abalone taco, sesame tofu and burdock tarte
Ground-floor view of the kitchen, upstairs sunset views
Attentive service and thoughtful wine pairings
highlights_zh: 鲍鱼塔可、芝麻豆腐、牛蒡挞
一楼可观看厨房，二楼可赏日落
细致服务与用心的葡萄酒搭配

address_ko: 서울특별시 강남구 테헤란로 231, 센터필드 EAST 2층 E205호
address_en: E205, 2F, Center Field EAST, 231 Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul 06142
intro_en: Chef Allen Suh cooks French-leaning contemporary dishes built entirely on seasonal Korean produce, tracing each ingredient back to its source. The menu even comes with a map of where everything is grown or caught.
intro_zh: 主厨徐贤民（Allen Suh）以法式风格的时尚料理呈现韩国时令食材，并追溯每种食材的产地。菜单甚至附有一张标明食材种植或捕捞地点的地图。
highlights_en: Sourdough leavened with makgeolli yeast
Ingredient-sourcing map served with the menu
Elegant room with kitchen views; warm, polished service
highlights_zh: 以米酒酵母发酵的酸种面包
随菜单附上食材产地地图
可观看厨房的优雅空间，服务温暖周到

intro_en: Owner-chef Lee Jun builds his tasting menus as themed 'Episodes', each telling a story from opening to finale. Korean flavours meet contemporary technique in a white, minimalist room centred on the open kitchen.
intro_zh: 主厨兼店主李俊（Lee Jun）以主题式“Episode（篇章）”构建品鉴菜单，每一季都从序章到终章讲述一个故事。韩国风味与现代技法在以开放厨房为中心的白色极简空间中交汇。
highlights_en: Themed 'Episode' menus that change seasonally
Minimalist white room around an open kitchen
Elegant plating and attentive service
highlights_zh: 随季节更换的主题“Episode”菜单
以开放厨房为中心的白色极简空间
优雅摆盘与周到服务

intro_en: A sushi counter of just eight seats tucked inside a traditional hanok near Seoul Station, promoted to two stars in 2026. Chef Park Kyung-jae's omakase moves from seasonal small plates to finely judged nigiri, finishing with matcha.
intro_zh: 仅设八个座位的寿司吧台，隐身于首尔站附近的传统韩屋中，2026年晋升二星。朴景在（Park Kyung-jae）主厨的无菜单料理以时令小菜开场，继而是精准的握寿司，最后以抹茶收尾。
highlights_en: Eight-seat counter inside a hanok
Cod roe with hairy crab, grilled hairtail, gizzard shad nigiri
Quiet garden retreat against the city skyline
highlights_zh: 韩屋内仅八席的吧台
毛蟹配鳕鱼子、烤带鱼、小鳍鱼握寿司
城市天际线下的静谧花园

intro_en: Chef Kim Dae-chun's counter restaurant is devoted to fermentation and ageing, and the name refers to seven tastes: the five basic ones plus fermentation/ageing and the chef's own sensibility. Each course explores how time transforms Korean ingredients.
intro_zh: 金大天（Kim Dae-chun）主厨的吧台餐厅专注于发酵与熟成，店名意为“七种味道”：五种基本味，加上发酵与熟成，以及主厨自身的感性。每道菜都在探索时间如何改变韩国食材。
highlights_en: Menu built on fermentation and dry-ageing
Chef's-table counter seating
Name refers to the 'seven tastes' of food
highlights_zh: 以发酵与熟成为核心的菜单
主厨餐桌式吧台座位
店名寓意食物的“七种味道”

address_en: 81F, Lotte World Tower, 300 Olympic-ro, Songpa-gu, Seoul 05551
intro_en: Run by the dining arm of ceramics group Kwangjuyo, Bicena serves seasonal Korean courses 81 floors above the city in Lotte World Tower. The chef draws on the produce and traditions of his native Gyeongsang province, with a particular strength in meat.
intro_zh: 由陶瓷集团广州窑旗下餐饮部门经营，比彩娜在乐天世界大厦81层供应时令韩式套餐。主厨取材于家乡庆尚道的物产与饮食传统，尤其擅长肉类料理。
highlights_en: House dry-aged Hanwoo sirloin and pork belly
81st-floor city views and private rooms
Courses named after the ten traditional longevity symbols
highlights_zh: 自家干式熟成韩牛西冷与五花肉
81层城市景观与私人包间
以传统“十长生”命名的套餐

address_ko: 서울특별시 강남구 논현로136길 11, 아난티 앳 강남 2층
address_en: 2F, Ananti at Gangnam, 11 Nonhyeon-ro 136-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul 06051
intro_en: Chef Noh Jin-sung's dinner-only restaurant inside the Ananti at Gangnam hotel layers seasonal Korean produce and fermentation onto a classical French base. As the name suggests, plates are assembled from contrasting elements—pure ingredient flavours set against rich, glossy sauces.
intro_zh: 主厨卢振成（Noh Jin-sung）位于Ananti at Gangnam酒店内、仅供应晚餐的餐厅，在经典法餐基础上融入韩国时令食材与发酵技法。正如店名“拼贴”，每道菜由对比鲜明的元素组成——食材本味与浓郁酱汁相互映衬。
highlights_en: Classic French sauces meet Korean fermentation
Stylish counter seating in a design-led hotel
Dinner only, Tuesday to Saturday
highlights_zh: 经典法式酱汁与韩国发酵技法结合
设计感酒店中的时尚吧台座位
仅周二至周六供应晚餐

address_ko: 서울특별시 강남구 테헤란로 231, 조선 팰리스 서울 강남 36층
intro_en: Set on the 36th floor of Josun Palace and styled as a garden in the sky, Eatanic Garden serves modern Korean courses led by chef Son Jong-won. The menu follows the seasons and spotlights native Korean ingredients, such as heirloom rice varieties.
intro_zh: 伊塔尼克花园位于朝鲜皇宫酒店36层，以“空中花园”为设计概念，由孙钟元（Son Jong-won）主厨主理现代韩式套餐。菜单随季节变化，突出韩国本土食材，如传统稻米品种。
highlights_en: Illustrated card explaining each dish's key ingredient
Garden-themed room with window tables over Gangnam
Seasonal menu; closed Mondays and Tuesdays
highlights_zh: 每道菜附有介绍主要食材的插画卡片
花园主题空间，窗边座位俯瞰江南
时令菜单；周一、周二休息

intro_en: Tucked into a Hannam-dong basement, Escondido (Spanish for 'hidden') was the first Mexican restaurant in Asia to earn a MICHELIN star. Chef Jin Woo-beom, who trained in Mexico, builds his menu on tortillas pressed daily from freshly nixtamalised corn masa and on complex moles made with dozens of ingredients. The goal is to show Korean diners the depth of Mexican cooking well beyond Tex-Mex.
intro_zh: Escondido 藏身于汉南洞的地下一层，店名在西班牙语中意为“隐藏”，是亚洲首家获得米其林星级的墨西哥餐厅。曾在墨西哥学艺的主厨陈宇范每天用现磨玉米面团手压玉米饼，并以数十种食材熬制层次丰富的莫莱酱，意在让韩国食客认识到远超 Tex-Mex 的墨西哥料理深度。
highlights_en: House-made heirloom-corn tortillas and moles such as mole negro and mole verde
Intimate counter where guests watch the chef at work
Tasting menu pairs well with mezcal, tequila or cocktails
highlights_zh: 自制传统玉米饼，以及黑莫莱、青莫莱等招牌酱汁
私密吧台座位，可近距离观看主厨烹饪
套餐适合搭配梅斯卡尔、龙舌兰或鸡尾酒

intro_en: Chef-owner Jang Kyung-won runs this small Cheongdam dining room on a quiet residential street, where the chefs themselves cook and bring dishes to the table. His contemporary menus showcase Korean regional produce and herbs grown by the restaurant, changing frequently with what is in season. It is one of the more approachably priced starred tasting menus in Gangnam.
intro_zh: 主厨兼店主张庆源在清潭洞一条安静的住宅街上经营这家小餐厅，由厨师亲自烹调并上菜。创意套餐以韩国各地农产与自家种植的香草为主角，菜单随时令频繁更换，是江南区价格相对亲民的星级套餐之一。
highlights_en: Frequently changing menus built on Korean regional ingredients and house-grown herbs
Compact, softly lit black-and-grey minimalist room
Chefs serve guests directly for a relaxed, personal feel
highlights_zh: 以韩国各地食材与自种香草为基础、频繁更新的菜单
灯光柔和的黑灰极简风小型餐室
由厨师直接上菜，氛围轻松亲切

intro_en: A husband-and-wife team, Won Jin-hee (ex-Kurogi, Tokyo) and Choi Hyun-ah (ex-Kanda, Tokyo), serve a single-seating kaiseki dinner at a Cheongdam counter. The courses follow the Japanese seasons closely and favour labour-intensive touches such as hand-pulled somen, freshly ground sesame and bracken-starch warabi mochi. Promoted to one star in 2026.
intro_zh: 由夫妻主厨元真熙（曾任职东京“黑木”）与崔贤雅（曾任职东京“神田”）主理，在清潭洞的吧台以一轮制晚宴呈现怀石料理。菜品紧扣日本四季，重视手工细节，如手拉素面、现磨芝麻和蕨粉制作的蕨饼。2026 年升为一星。
highlights_en: Signature Kurogi-style somen topped with sea urchin and caviar; seasonal hassun
Counter seating with every course finished and explained in front of guests
One dinner seating that starts together at 7 p.m.
highlights_zh: 招牌黑木风素面配海胆与鱼子酱，以及时令八寸
吧台座位，每道菜在客人面前完成并讲解
晚间单轮制，19:00 全员同时开席

price: Essence ₩220,000 / Selection ₩260,000 / Chef's Tasting ₩290,000 (vegetarian versions at the same prices)
intro_en: Chef Jung Ha-wan cooks vegetable-led Mediterranean food in a farm-to-table set-up: most of the organic produce comes from a farm run by his family about 40 km outside Seoul. The kitchen cuts waste, avoids single-use plastics and turns scraps into farm compost, which earned Gigas a MICHELIN Green Star alongside its one star.
intro_zh: 主厨郑夏完以蔬菜为核心烹制地中海料理，采用“从农场到餐桌”模式，大部分有机食材来自其家人在首尔约 40 公里外经营的农场。厨房减少浪费、不用一次性塑料，并将厨余制成农场堆肥，因此除一星外还获得米其林绿星。
highlights_en: Seasonal vegetables and herbs, mostly from the chef's family organic farm
Three tasting menus, each also offered in a vegetarian version
Dining room styled with rocks and trees; sustainability-focused kitchen
highlights_zh: 时令蔬菜与香草，大多来自主厨家族的有机农场
三档品鉴套餐，均提供素食版本
以岩石和树木装饰的餐厅，厨房注重可持续

intro_en: Opened in 2024 by French-trained chef Kang Min-chul as the Korean sibling to his namesake restaurant, GiwaKang reworks traditional Korean flavours with classic French technique. Dishes pair the familiar with the luxurious, and the restaurant ages its own jang (soy sauce, doenjang, gochujang). It won a star in its first appearance in 2026, and its sommelier Lee Jung-in received the MICHELIN Sommelier Award.
intro_zh: 由受法式训练的主厨姜珉哲于 2024 年开设，是其同名法餐厅的韩餐姊妹店，以经典法式技法重新诠释传统韩国风味，将家常滋味与奢华食材相搭配，并自制陈酿酱油、大酱和辣椒酱。2026 年首次入选即获一星，侍酒师李贞仁同时获得米其林侍酒师奖。
highlights_en: Signatures: dongchimi with caviar, ganjang gejang rice with truffle, squid mandu
Modern, elegant room with an open kitchen; private rooms available
Award-winning wine programme and polished service
highlights_zh: 招牌：鱼子酱配水泡菜、松露酱蟹拌饭、鱿鱼饺子
设开放式厨房的现代雅致空间，另有包间
获奖的葡萄酒单与周到细致的服务

intro_en: Chef Kim Geon's 'small-dish' restaurant near Dosan Park serves a dinner-only omakase of contemporary Japanese-leaning cooking driven by peak-season ingredients. Most guests sit at an eight-seat bar facing the chef, and the drinks list focuses on sake from small Japanese breweries, making the meal as much about pairing as about the food.
intro_zh: 主厨金健在岛山公园附近经营的“小料理”餐厅，只供应晚间无菜单料理，以当季顶级食材呈现带日式风格的创意菜。多数客人坐在面对主厨的八人吧台，酒单专注日本小型酒藏的清酒，餐与酒的搭配同样是重点。
highlights_en: Seasonal omakase with a contemporary Japanese sensibility
Eight-seat main counter facing the chef
Curated sake list from small Japanese breweries
highlights_zh: 具当代日式风格的时令无菜单料理
面向主厨的八席主吧台
精选日本小型酒藏清酒

intro_en: Housed in a modern white building in Sinsa-dong, Hakusi is a grill-focused Japanese counter restaurant with charcoal-and-fire design cues. Its best-known dish is crispy unagi served two ways: first classically with sansho, then wrapped Peking-duck style in a thin pancake with basil. Promoted to one star in 2026; a late-night à la carte option runs after 9 p.m.
intro_zh: Hakusi 位于新沙洞一栋现代白色建筑内，是以炭烤为核心的日式吧台餐厅，室内以黑与红呼应炭与火。招牌是酥脆鳗鱼的两种吃法：先配山椒按传统享用，再像北京烤鸭般用薄饼卷上罗勒。2026 年升为一星，晚上 9 点后另有单点。
highlights_en: Signature crispy unagi served two ways; truffle chicken wings; finishing pudding
Open kitchen with counter seats facing the grill
À la carte and a shorter signature course after 9 p.m.
highlights_zh: 招牌酥脆鳗鱼两吃、松露鸡翅与收尾布丁
开放式厨房，吧台座位正对炭烤区
晚上 9 点后提供单点和精简招牌套餐

intro_en: Near Gyeonghuigung Palace, JUEUN serves classic Korean cuisine that follows the four seasons rather than trends. Fermented sauces underpin the menu, and the courses build towards a traditional Korean rice-table finale. Korean ceramics and subtle media art set the scene, and the drinks pairing mixes traditional Korean spirits with wine. Promoted to one star in 2026.
intro_zh: JUEUN 位于庆熙宫附近，以经典韩餐呈现四季更迭而不追逐潮流。菜单以发酵酱料为根基，层层推进，最后以传统韩式饭桌收尾。空间以韩国陶瓷和低调的媒体艺术点缀，配酒结合韩国传统酒与葡萄酒。2026 年升为一星。
highlights_en: Seasonal Korean courses rooted in jang (fermented sauces), ending with a traditional bansang
8th-floor room near Gyeonghuigung with Korean ceramics and media art
Pairings of traditional Korean liquors and wine
highlights_zh: 以发酵酱为根基的时令韩餐，以传统饭床收尾
庆熙宫旁八楼空间，陈设韩国陶瓷与媒体艺术
韩国传统酒与葡萄酒搭配

intro_en: Chef Kang Min-chul, who trained in top French kitchens, reinterprets classic French haute cuisine through Korean and wider Asian ingredients picked up on his travels and collaborations. Expect French structure with unexpected accents, such as a burnt dried-bamboo-shoot and blueberry sauce or a shiitake-and-miyeok broth. The restaurant moved in 2025 to a larger, brighter Cheongdam space with a nature-inspired design.
intro_zh: 曾在顶级法餐厨房历练的主厨姜珉哲，借助旅行与合作中接触的韩国及亚洲食材重新诠释经典法式高级料理。菜品保留法式骨架，又加入意想不到的元素，如焦烤笋干蓝莓酱、香菇海带高汤。餐厅于 2025 年迁至清潭洞更宽敞明亮、以自然为灵感的新址。
highlights_en: French classics reworked with Korean/Asian ingredients; opens with a parade of amuse-bouches
Bright, earth-toned dining room (relocated 2025)
Extensive wine list with pairing options
highlights_zh: 以韩国及亚洲食材重塑法式经典，开场有多道餐前小点
大地色调的明亮餐厅（2025 年迁址）
丰富酒单并提供配酒

area_zh: 中区 明洞一带（会贤站附近）
intro_en: On the 26th floor of the L'Escape Hotel, chef Son Jong-won cooks what he calls Korean-style Western cuisine: Western technique applied to Korean seasonal produce. The intimate, Paris-inspired room overlooks central Seoul, and the menus are playful and personal, with some dishes drawing on the chef's travels, such as coffee-inspired creations.
intro_zh: 位于 L'Escape 酒店 26 楼，主厨孙钟元将其风格称为“韩式西餐”，即以西式技法处理韩国时令食材。巴黎风格的私密餐室俯瞰首尔市中心，菜单富有趣味和个人色彩，部分菜品灵感来自主厨的旅行经历，如以咖啡为灵感的创作。
highlights_en: Korean seasonal ingredients cooked with Western techniques
Intimate 26th-floor dining room with Parisian styling and city views
Lunch and dinner chef's tasting menus with optional wine pairing
highlights_zh: 以西式技法烹调韩国时令食材
26 楼巴黎风私密餐厅，可眺望城市景色
午晚餐主厨品鉴套餐，可选配酒

intro_en: One of Seoul's long-standing French restaurants, L'Amitié has been run by chef-owner Jang Myoung-sik since 2006. His cooking is classic and ingredient-first, letting seasonal produce speak with restrained sauces and precise technique. Jang received the MICHELIN Mentor Chef Award in 2022 for training a generation of Korean cooks.
intro_zh: L'Amitié 是首尔资深法餐厅之一，自 2006 年起由主厨兼店主张明植掌勺。料理风格经典，以食材为先，用克制的酱汁和精准技法突出时令风味。张明植因培养了一代韩国厨师，于 2022 年获得米其林导师主厨奖。
highlights_en: Classic French set menus, e.g. Korean beef tenderloin with gratin dauphinois
Bright, airy second-floor dining room, good for groups
Chef-owner with nearly two decades at the stove and a 2022 Mentor Chef Award
highlights_zh: 经典法式套餐，如韩牛菲力配多菲内焗土豆
明亮通透的二楼餐厅，适合聚餐
掌勺近二十年的主厨兼店主，2022 年米其林导师主厨奖得主

intro_en: Owner-chef Sung Si-woo runs a fully plant-based tasting menu that draws on Korea's long tradition of vegetable and temple-style cooking while staying firmly contemporary. Without any animal products, the kitchen builds depth and texture that convince committed meat-eaters too.
intro_zh: 店主兼主厨成始宇打造全植物性品鉴套餐，汲取韩国蔬食与寺庙料理传统，又保持鲜明的当代风格。完全不使用动物性食材，却做出足以打动肉食者的层次与口感。
highlights_en: 100% vegan contemporary tasting menu rooted in Korean vegetable cookery
Counter seating in a compact Sinsa-dong space
Good for solo diners; appeals to non-vegetarians as well
highlights_zh: 植根于韩国蔬食传统的百分百纯素创意套餐
新沙洞小巧空间，设吧台座位
适合独自用餐，非素食者同样喜爱

address_ko: 서울 강남구 도산대로70길 26 청담 피에트라 지하2층
intro_en: Behind an understated entrance, Muni centres on a long counter facing an open kitchen, with the chef's collection of ceramics lining the shelves. Chef Kim Dong-wook borrows the spirit of kaiseki rather than its strict rules, serving a seasonal omakase of simple, elegant dishes made with top Japanese and Korean produce. A certified sake sommelier, he guides pairings himself.
intro_zh: Muni 入口低调，店内以面对开放式厨房的长吧台为中心，架上陈列着主厨收藏的器皿。主厨金东旭借鉴怀石精神而不拘泥于规则，以日韩顶级食材呈现简洁优雅的时令无菜单料理。他本人是认证清酒唎酒师，可亲自推荐配酒。
highlights_en: Kaiseki-inspired seasonal omakase, dinner only
Minimalist room with a long counter and the chef's ceramic collection
Sake pairings chosen by the chef, a certified kikisakeshi
highlights_zh: 受怀石启发的时令无菜单料理，仅供晚餐
极简空间，长吧台与主厨收藏器皿
由认证唎酒师主厨亲选清酒搭配

intro_en: Named after the word for oak, Muoki has held a star since 2019. Chef Park Moo-hyun's style is to take one ingredient and cook it several ways in a single dish, layering flavour and texture, as in his 'carrot five ways' or 'tomato seven ways'. A large team works in a raised open kitchen, and the desserts are a frequent highlight.
intro_zh: Muoki 取名自“橡树”，自 2019 年起一直保持一星。主厨朴武炫擅长将一种食材以多种手法烹调并组合在一道菜中，层层叠加风味与口感，如“五种胡萝卜”“七种番茄”。众多厨师在抬高的开放式厨房中工作，甜点常是亮点。
highlights_en: Signature Muoki Egg (chicken-liver mousse shaped as an egg); one-ingredient-many-ways dishes
Raised open kitchen with a large brigade and counter seats
Strong dessert courses; servers guide diners through the set menu
highlights_zh: 招牌“Muoki 蛋”（塑成蛋形的鸡肝慕斯），以及一物多做的菜品
抬高的开放式厨房，厨师团队庞大，设吧台座位
甜点出色，服务员引导客人体验套餐

intro_en: Onjium's dining room is run by a research institute devoted to Korean heritage, so its menus come out of archival study of Joseon-era aristocratic and royal cookbooks. The kitchen reworks those recipes with seasonal produce and modern technique, aiming for a restrained, clean style of hansik.
intro_zh: 温知音的餐厅隶属于一家研究韩国传统文化的机构，菜单源自对朝鲜时代宫廷与两班家族古食谱的考据。厨房以时令食材和现代手法重新诠释这些菜式，追求克制、清雅的韩食风格。
highlights_en: Menus based on research into historic royal and yangban recipes
Fourth-floor room looking out over the stone wall of Gyeongbokgung Palace
Counter seats facing the kitchen, with wine or traditional-liquor pairings
highlights_zh: 菜单以宫廷及两班古食谱研究为基础
四楼餐厅正对景福宫石墙
吧台座位可看厨房，提供葡萄酒或传统酒搭配

price: Tasting menu ₩350,000 (same course at lunch and dinner)
intro_en: Opened around 2024 and starred for the first time in 2026, SAN serves a single tasting menu that rebuilds familiar Korean comfort food in a refined, inventive way. Chef Jo draws on his Busan upbringing, so dishes like pork gukbap or milmyeon arrive in unexpected new forms.
intro_zh: SAN约于2024年开业，2026年首度摘星，只提供一套品鉴菜单，以精致而富有创意的方式重构韩国家常味道。主厨赵承贤从釜山成长经历中汲取灵感，猪肉汤饭、小麦冷面等菜式都以出人意料的面貌呈现。
highlights_en: Reimagined Busan classics such as dwaeji-gukbap with caviar and milmyeon
Basement dining room styled to feel like a quiet forest
Calm, unobtrusive service with considered wine pairings
highlights_zh: 重新演绎釜山经典：鱼子酱猪肉汤饭、小麦冷面
地下餐厅营造静谧森林氛围
服务安静周到，葡萄酒搭配用心

intro_en: Solbam, whose name evokes a pine forest at night, is chef-owner Eom Tae-jun's dinner-only restaurant applying modern technique to Korean seasonal produce. The evening is staged in two acts, starting with drinks and snacks in a dim lounge before moving to a bright open-kitchen dining room.
intro_zh: Solbam意为“松林之夜”，是主厨严太俊的晚餐专营餐厅，以现代技法演绎韩国时令食材。用餐分两幕：先在昏暗的会客室享用饮品和小食，再移步明亮的开放式厨房餐区。
highlights_en: Dishes such as snow crab with cauliflower and Hanwoo with wild chive
Dim lounge for aperitifs, then a bright open-kitchen dining room
Three- or seven-glass wine pairings; dinner only
highlights_zh: 招牌菜如雪蟹配花椰菜、韩牛配野蒜
先在昏暗会客室用开胃酒，再到明亮开放厨房餐区
提供3杯或7杯葡萄酒搭配，仅供晚餐

intro_en: Soseoul Hannam builds its courses from the everyday Korean table: namul, jeon, jjim and stews made with ingredients locals know well. The cooking is polished but intentionally homely, which makes it an approachable introduction to contemporary hansik.
intro_zh: 小说汉南以韩国人日常餐桌为灵感组织套餐，凉拌菜、煎饼、炖菜和汤锅都选用本地人熟悉的食材。烹调精致却刻意保留家常感，是了解当代韩食的亲切入口。
highlights_en: Kelp chips, rich doenjang stew, and raw fish with gomchwi and aged kimchi
Chargrilled webfoot octopus among the signatures
Good selection of traditional Korean liquors in a basement room in Hannam
highlights_zh: 海带脆片、浓郁大酱汤、生鱼片配熊蔬与陈年泡菜
炭烤短爪章鱼为招牌之一
汉南洞地下餐厅，传统韩国酒选择丰富

intro_en: Soul is run by husband-and-wife chefs: Yoon Dae-hyun, trained in Western cooking, and Kim Hee-eun, trained in Korean cooking. Their courses bring Korean ingredients and traditions together with familiar, comforting flavours in a stylish basement space in Haebangchon.
intro_zh: Soul由一对夫妻主厨经营，尹大铉擅长西餐，金熙恩专攻韩餐。两人将韩国食材与传统融入亲切熟悉的味道，餐厅位于解放村一处时髦的地下空间。
highlights_en: Courses blending Korean and Western training from two chef-owners
Space split into distinct zones, including counter seating
Hillside Haebangchon location below Namsan
highlights_zh: 两位主厨融合韩式与西式功底的套餐
空间分为不同区域，设吧台座位
位于南山脚下的解放村坡地

address_ko: 서울특별시 강남구 테헤란로 521, 그랜드 인터컨티넨탈 서울 파르나스 1층
address_en: 1F, Grand InterContinental Seoul Parnas, 521 Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul 06164
price: Chef Tamaru (Tue–Sat): Lunch ₩280,000 / Dinner ₩380,000; Chef Jo Bong-su (Sun–Mon): Lunch ₩230,000 / Dinner ₩330,000
intro_en: This Seoul outpost of Tokyo's Sushi Kanesaka sits inside the hotel's Japanese restaurant Hinotsuki and gained its star in 2026. A Japanese chef leads a Korean team, using mostly Korean seasonal seafood and Korean rice seasoned to resemble Japanese shari.
intro_zh: 东京名店鮨かねさか的首尔分店位于酒店日料餐厅Hinotsuki内，2026年首度摘星。由日本主厨带领韩国团队，主要使用韩国当季海鲜，并以韩国米调味出接近日式醋饭的口感。
highlights_en: Eight-seat hinoki counter tucked inside Hinotsuki
Edomae-style nigiri using mostly Korean-caught seasonal fish
Same sushi at lunch and dinner; dinner adds more cooked dishes
highlights_zh: 隐身于Hinotsuki内的八席桧木吧台
江户前寿司，鱼获多为韩国当季海产
午晚餐寿司相同，晚餐增加更多料理

intro_en: Japanese chef Mizuho Matsumoto serves sushi in Cheongdam the way it is done in Japan, without chasing trends. An omakase opens with tsumami small plates and then moves into a nigiri sequence paced to build flavour naturally.
intro_zh: 日本主厨松本瑞穗在清潭洞呈现地道日式寿司，不追随潮流。无菜单料理以下酒小菜开场，随后进入节奏自然、层层递进的握寿司环节。
highlights_en: Classic Japanese-style omakase by a Japanese chef
Strong tsumami course before the nigiri
Counter seating with a notable sake list
highlights_zh: 日本主厨主理的正统日式无菜单料理
握寿司前的下酒小菜颇具水准
吧台座位，清酒单出色

area_zh: 城东区 圣水洞二街
intro_en: Named for the French habit of switching to the informal 'tu', Tutoiement reflects chef Kim Do-hyun's wish to talk to guests casually through his food. Behind the relaxed name is precise, classically grounded French cooking where sauces and garnishes are balanced with care.
intro_zh: 店名取自法语中改用亲昵称呼“tu”的习惯，体现主厨金度贤希望用料理与客人轻松交流的心意。轻松的名字背后是精准、扎实的经典法餐，酱汁与配菜的平衡拿捏细致。
highlights_en: Precise, classical French technique with carefully built sauces
Relaxed, friendly tone in contrast to the refined cooking
Located in Seoul's trendy Seongsu district
highlights_zh: 精准的经典法式技法，酱汁讲究
氛围轻松亲切，与精致料理形成对比
位于首尔潮流街区圣水洞

intro_en: VINHO is a counter restaurant where co-owner chef Jeon Sung-bin mixes Korean tradition, modern technique and his own style into a seasonal course. Wine is central to the concept, so the pairing is part of how the meal is designed.
intro_zh: VINHO是一家吧台式餐厅，联合主厨全成彬将韩国传统、现代技法与个人风格融入时令套餐。葡萄酒是餐厅的核心概念，搭配酒款本身就是整套设计的一部分。
highlights_en: Dark counter wrapped around an open kitchen in an industrial-style room
Minimalist plating with subtle, expressive flavours
Wine pairing, with a strong focus on Champagne
highlights_zh: 工业风空间，深色吧台环绕开放厨房
极简摆盘，风味细腻而富有表现力
葡萄酒搭配，尤重香槟

area_zh: 江南区 新沙洞（岛山公园）
intro_en: y'east plays on yeast and the idea of endless culinary growth, and chef Cho Young-dong uses it to reinvent familiar dishes in his own visual language. He often works with ingredients rarely seen in Korea, yet keeps the original dish's essence recognisable.
intro_zh: y'east取“酵母”与无限成长之意，主厨赵英东借此以个人美学重塑人们熟悉的菜式。他常用韩国少见的食材，却始终保留原菜的精髓。
highlights_en: Kaya-toast-inspired amuse-bouche
Playful signatures such as the 'galbi stone'
Third-floor dining room near Dosan Park
highlights_zh: 灵感来自咖椰吐司的开胃小点
趣味招牌菜如“排骨石”
位于岛山公园附近的三楼餐厅

area_zh: 钟路区 唐珠洞（光化门）
address_ko: 서울특별시 종로구 새문안로 97, 포시즌스 호텔 서울 11층
address_en: 11F, Four Seasons Hotel Seoul, 97 Saemunan-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul 03183
intro_en: Yu Yuan is the Four Seasons Seoul's Chinese restaurant, set in an elegant, comfortable room with a Peking duck station by the entrance. The menu is mainly Cantonese, with dim sum a lunchtime favourite, plus dishes from other regions of China.
intro_zh: 愉园是首尔四季酒店的中餐厅，环境雅致舒适，入口处设有北京烤鸭展示台。菜单以粤菜为主，午市点心广受欢迎，也有中国其他地区的菜式。
highlights_en: Peking duck and wok-fried Hoengseong Hanwoo beef with ginger
Popular dim sum at lunch and weekend dim sum brunch
Elegant hotel dining room near Gwanghwamun, suited to groups
highlights_zh: 北京烤鸭、姜葱爆炒横城韩牛
午市点心及周末点心早午餐人气高
光化门附近的雅致酒店餐厅，适合聚餐

intro_en: Chef-owner Kim Do-yun is obsessed with ingredients and especially noodles, and his Korean tasting course centres on aging, fermenting and drying. Guests sit at the counter while he explains the slow preparation behind each dish.
intro_zh: 主厨金度润痴迷于食材，尤其钟情面条，他的韩式品鉴套餐以熟成、发酵和干燥工艺为核心。客人坐在吧台前，听他讲解每道菜背后漫长的准备过程。
highlights_en: Fermentation-driven Korean course with handmade noodles such as perilla noodles
Counter seating where the chef explains each preparation
Sister noodle shop Myeon Seoul right next door
highlights_zh: 以发酵为核心的韩式套餐，有紫苏籽面等手作面条
吧台座位，主厨亲自讲解每道工序
隔壁即姊妹面馆“面首尔”

intro_en: Opened in 2014 by Lee Choong-hu, who in 2017 became Korea's youngest Michelin-starred chef, Zero Complex has kept its experimental edge through two moves. The cooking treats ingredients in unexpected ways, and the restaurant now sits in a quiet residential pocket of Seobinggo with a garden view.
intro_zh: 零度空间由李忠厚于2014年创立，他在2017年成为韩国最年轻的米其林星级主厨。餐厅两度搬迁仍保持实验精神，以出人意料的方式处理食材，如今位于西冰库洞安静住宅区，可眺望庭院。
highlights_en: Signature Pacific geoduck with chewy barley, sea spaghetti and sea-mustard mousse
Garden-view room in a quiet residential street (a little hard to find)
Creative, ingredient-led courses with wine pairing
highlights_zh: 招牌太平洋象拔蚌配大麦、海意面与裙带菜慕斯
安静住宅区内的庭院景观餐厅（较难找）
以食材为核心的创意套餐，可配葡萄酒
